## Validation

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter contains only `name` and `description`.
- [ ] Skill body stays concise.
- [ ] References are source-backed.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py skills` passes.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_agents.py agents` passes if agent profiles changed.

- [ ] README/docs updated if public behavior changed.
